en:
<CLT=cltMIND>Every time I come here, I play the
role of their "ideal." Like some shared fantasy.

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder how it will be with Kirumi.
I don't know if she has any weird fantasies.
Master Shuichi...
...Huh? Me?
Yes, of course...

Ah, I was confused because
you called me "<CLT=cltSTRONG>master<CLT=cltNORMAL>"...
Because you are my master.

I, Kirumi Tojo, will offer everything that
I have to Master Shuichi.

<CLT=cltMIND>This is Kirumi's fantasy?
I'm part of her dream...?

<CLT=cltMIND>It seems as though we have a
servant and master relationship.

<CLT=cltMIND>In any case, I can't break character now.
Kirumi would wake up from her dream...
<CLT=cltMIND>and feel terrible.

<CLT=cltMIND>I can't let that happen.
So for now, I'll play along.

Master Shuichi...
I must tell you something today.
What is it?

I was employed by the master...your father...
for a very long time.

However, that ends today.
I will leave the mansion tomorrow.
What!? Why this all of a sudden!?
That is because...
Shuichi, will you promise me something?

What I am about to tell you must 
remain here... My secret...

<CLT=cltMIND>Kirumi's voice became gravely
serious.
...Alright, I understand. I promise.
<CLT=cltMIND>I nodded firmly.
Thank you very much.

I am convinced you out of all people will
keep the promise, Master Shuichi.
Definitely...since you are the man I love...
I'm what!? The man you love!?
I mean every word of it.

Although I am the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Maid<CLT=cltNORMAL>, I do not
know how to handle my own emotions.

<CLT=cltMIND>Kirumi looked more fragile than
I had ever seen before.

To be honest,
when I first laid eyes on you...

I was quite worried about your well-being
as the heir to the Saihara family.

I knew it was my destiny to nurture you
and help you grow.

I know I have not fulfilled my destiny yet,
but...

Somewhere along this path...
I became...attracted to you.

The generous smile you show to the weak...
Your wisdom as the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Detective<CLT=cltNORMAL>...

Although you are still unsure of your role,
you have the courage to move forward...

But most importantly...with your kindness...
You...treat me as an equal...
And that...is a problem?

I don't understand, Kirumi. I see you
as my equal, and a woman who—

You mustn't!
Please do not say such a thing!
What...?

You must remember your duty.
You are the heir to the Saihara family.
This is what I have feared...

My feelings will hinder you... They will 
pull you away from your destiny...
My love will become a bad influence to you.

That is why...I must leave.
My pride as a maid forces me to.

W-Wait a minute!
I don't understand!
What?

Your feelings of respect and love
for me can never be a bad thing!

I won't let you talk
that way, Kirumi!
Master...Shuichi...

<CLT=cltMIND>Kirumi didn't say anything
for a while. However...
U-Uuhhh...

<CLT=cltMIND>The calm, perfect composure she always
kept began to crack.
U-Uuhhh...uuhhh...

<CLT=cltMIND>As teardrops fell freely from her eyes,
she cried as a child would.
Waaaaahhh!!!
Kirumi...

<CLT=cltMIND>I reached out to her shaking shoulders
and held her tight, cradling her.

A-Aah... Master Shuichi!
Master Shuichi!

Are you sure...? Is it truly alright for
me to have these feelings for you?

Yes...of course.
Thank you...for expressing your feelings.
I am not worthy of such kind words...

I am infatuated with you...
I love you!

Please allow me to stand
by your side...forever!
<CLT=cltMIND>.........
<CLT=cltMIND>......
<CLT=cltMIND>...
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>You've acquired a new theme, "Love Suite."
